text:
emma: Helios reached out wanting a joint perf-per-watt benchmark next Wed. Scope: Redwood runtime vs Helios-tuned kernel on 8x A100-80GB. They want tok/joule, stable p99, and notes for the marketplace listing. Can we run in our lab?

rick: We can support. Need Helios kernel commit, exact CUDA/driver, and BMC access. Propose power caps: 220W, 280W, and unrestricted as baselines.

yu: I'll own energy telemetry. Plan: sync IPMI system power + NVML per-GPU readings at 1s, aggregate with monotonic timestamps. Also will record per-run system snapshots (top, nvidia-smi -q).

ananya: Marketing/product want metrics: tok/sec (mean + 99% CI), tok/joule, p95/p99 latency, and a short quality sanity check. Also a draft marketplace blurb and a simple table format.

tom: Helios eng here. We'll provide kernel commit helios/kernel@a1b2c3d4 and a small container with LD_PRELOAD=/opt/helios/tune.so. We'll join the run window and provide diff notes about scheduler tweaks and memcpy fusion.

yu: Two phases: cold (empty KV) and warm (prefill 2k tokens). Batch profiles: chat [1,2,4] and completion [8,16]. We'll repeat each config 5 times to estimate CIs.

bench-bot: Scheduled -> run_id=helios-2026-04-03-a ; command:
```
bench run --target a100-8x --model redwood-7b \\--profile chat:[1,2,4],completion:[8,16] \\--warmup 300 --repeats 5 --power-caps 220,280,0 \\--energy ipmi,nvml --counters sm_eff,dram_util,l2_hit,fc_util --eval sanity-50 --report csv
```

rick: CSV schema: run_id, partner, model, build_tag, batch_size, seq_len, phase, tokens, seconds, joules, tok_per_joule, tok_per_sec, p95_ms, p99_ms, ci_tok_per_sec, notes. We'll also snapshot perf counters every run.

ananya: Add an eval guard: 50 sanity prompts + 10 adversarial checks. Fail if semantic similarity delta >0.7% or perplexity delta >1%. Legal needs conservative phrasing in announcement.

legal-bot: Provide raw CSV, CI method, and avoid absolute "X% faster" headlines until validated across independent runs. Store logs for 90 days.

yu: Baseline software: Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA 12.2, driver 535.xx, cuDNN 9.x. If Helios uses a different minor version, note it in build_tag.

emma: Marketing timeline: preliminary numbers within 48h of run, joint tech note in 2 weeks. Kevin/marketing will need the table schema.

tom: Confirmed: Helios will attend the window and provide the tuned build tag helios-tune-v2. We'll also share the git diff before the run.

bench-bot: Lab booking requested for 2026-04-03 08:00-14:00 UTC. run_id=helios-2026-04-03-a queued by emma at 1752723520

emma: Please ack to lock the slot. I'll finalize the run plan and loop in Helios contact.

yu: Ack 10. Pushing telemetry harness and CI bootstrap now.

ananya: Ack. I'll draft the marketplace blurb and table and post to #marketing.

rick: Ack. Will push the CSV exporter and perf counter collector to the repo.

legal-bot: Acknowledged. I'll review the blurb draft and the claim language.

emma: Thanks team. If anyone thinks of extra metrics (e.g., kernel regressions, packet drops) add them today so we can include in the plan.
